Delivering ferocious combat, labyrinthine level design, and nightmarish realms that twist reality beyond recognition, it pushes the legacy of the genre-defining first-person shooter even further, honoring one of gaming’s most enduring icons.    END THE NIGHTMARE. ESCAPE THE ILLUSION  Ranger is trapped in a dimension of endless illusion, reliving the same violent cycles for what feels like lifetimes, dying thousands of times in a futile attempt to escape. Wearied but unbroken, he has heard rumor of The Nightmare Machine.   Beyond the hordes of monsters, twisted by an eternity in the Elder realms, lies the Machine. It is believed its destruction will shatter the illusion, finally breaking the loop.   For more information on Quake, follow these channels: X:   / quake   Instagram:   / quake   Facebook:   / quake   TikTok:   / bethesda   Website: ESRB RATING: Mature for Blood and Gore and Intense Violence.

title: THE ONLY LIVING PICKPOCKET IN NEW YORK | Official Trailer (2026)
description: A love-letter to New York City. Watch the official trailer for THE ONLY LIVING PICKPOCKET IN NEW YORK. Opens in NY & LA theaters October 23, nationwide October 30. Directed by: Noah Segan Starring: John Turturro, Giancarlo Esposito, Will Price, Tatiana Maslany, Victoria Moroles, Steve Buscemi, and Jamie Lee Curtis Harry Lehman (John Turturro) is an aging pickpocket who plies his trade with ever-diminishing returns in a drastically changed New York. title: The Dukes of Hazzard (2027) – Matt Damon, Jake Gyllenhaal, Inde Navarrette | Concept Trailer
description: Watch This Dukes of Hazzard Last Run Fan-Made Concept Trailer Featuring Matt Damon, Jake Gyllenhaal, Inde Navarrette, Richard Gere, Nicolas Cage and Daniel Craig What if the Duke boys grew up and the rebellion died and the General Lee sat under a dusty tarp in a barn for fifteen years with flat tires and fading paint while the county that raised them was gutted one family at a time by a corporation that buys small towns, strip-mines their land, and moves on? This 2027 concept trailer reimagines The Dukes of Hazzard as a gritty, emotionally devastating Southern thriller that opens in a Hazzard County that is dying quietly, half the storefronts boarded up and the two cousins who once outran every sheriff in Georgia sitting on opposite ends of the country refusing to speak. Matt Damon delivers a weathered performance as Bo Duke, the reckless kid who could thread a Charger through a creek gap at ninety now running a small repair shop after two years in lockup, a man who drinks too much and drives too slow because fifteen years of guilt buried the fire. Jake Gyllenhaal brings quiet pain to Luke Duke, the cousin who left Hazzard and never came back, driving long-haul freight across the country, sleeping in truck stops, running from the truth that he started the fight that put Bo in prison. When a forged eminent domain notice arrives telling Richard Gere's Uncle Jesse that the family farm has been sold from under him, the old man leaves a six-word voicemail that brings Luke's rig turning around and puts both cousins back on the same porch for the first time in years. I personally created every storyboard and visual element in this "What If" concept trailer from scratch, building a story that surrounds the Duke family with forces powerful enough to crush them and earns every second of the resurrection that follows. Inde Navarrette brings fierce quiet strength to Daisy Duke, the cousin who stayed when everyone else left, running the Boar's Nest, listening to every conversation, mapping every back road and creek crossing because someone had to watch the county die and know the way out when the time came. Nicolas Cage is manic and desperately sympathetic as Boss Hogg, a puppet of the corporation he thought he was partnering with. Daniel Craig is the most dangerous man to ever set foot in Hazzard as Colonel Briggs, a former military contractor who burns barns and nails a dead copperhead to the Duke farmhouse door without leaving a trace. Tom Hiddleston is chillingly polished as Harlan Whitmore, the corporate CEO who sets fine china inside a gutted farmhouse and offers three times market value with a smile that never reaches his eyes. Every frame was crafted to build toward the moment Uncle Jesse walks into the burned barn and finds the General Lee still standing, looks at Bo and says two words that restart everything, and the last run that follows, a back-road chase through dirt, gravel, creek crossings, and a thirty-foot jump over a washed-out bridge that sends a dust-covered 1969 muscle car screaming into downtown Atlanta carrying Hazzard County on its body and the evidence that brings the whole corrupt empire crashing down. title: Bungie released One More Surprise Update for Destiny 2...
description: New Destiny 2 News after what was supposed to be the latest TWAB (TWID) on Aug 4 in Destiny 2: Monument of Triumph (June Update)! We have the First Community TWID! Bungie Surprised Destiny 2 Players with another Small but much-wanted Update to the game! And people HAVE FOUND A WAY TO LOAD INTO THE LEVIATHAN RAID IN 2026! --FOLLOW ME ON TWITCH: --CHECK OUT THE COMMUNITY TWID HERE: --- My Twitter: New video, going over the latest Destiny 2 News from the New Weekly Update (What was supposed to be the final TWAB aka Final TWID) on August 4th in the new Monument of Triumph Update, the New Destiny 2 Update with Destiny 2 Ending, after the Launch of the New Destiny 2 Renegades Expansion! Monument of Triumph is here and we have the Destiny 2 News from the New TWAB (This week at Bungie) or TWID (This Week in Destiny), during Destiny 2 Monument of Triumph! This is after Destiny 2: Renegades, and The Edge of Fate DLC. The Renegades Expansion brought a new Campaign, and the "Lawless Frontiers" Activity! Pledge to the different Syndicates (Totality Division, The Pikers, or Tharsis Reformation), and complete Bounties in the Lawless Frontier, secure Contested Zones, and fend off Invaders! Get the new Praxic Blade Exotic Sword (Destiny 2 Lightsaber), and play the new Equilibrium Dungeon! But now We have the Monument Of Triumph! The Last Destiny 2 Update Ever! It brings Pantheon 2.0 (Calus Resplendent and Morgeth Surpassing) As well as Updated Destinations, New Exotic Catalysts, the new Secret Exotic Quest and Secret Exotic Mission for the Cull's Shadow, Sparrow Racing League (SRL), and more! But today we're going over the new Destiny 2 news from the New Destiny 2 Reset, and more! We have new featured raids and dungeons with absolutely god tier armor that will be tier 5! We had the last patch ever, but this week bungie actually made another small Updates fixing things! The a free god roll Zavala Weapon from Vanguard Armory is back! And the Europa Armor set was disabled in pvp! And someone figured out how to Load into the Leviathan Raid in 2026!
